text: Coffee with Bethany. Her birthday's next Saturday and she's been going on about pottery classes. Probably a voucher for the studio on Mill Lane. She's off dairy at the moment too, so no cake from the usual place.
Rahul's veggie but eats fish, and Sunil doesn't drink at all. Worth knowing before the curry night Friday at 7.

Bogdan rang. His dad turns 70 on the 12th and they're doing a lunch at the Polish club. He's stressed about the speech, says he can't write anything that doesn't sound like a eulogy. I should send him a couple of lines tomorrow evening.
Pick up the dry cleaning Thursday before 6, and the car's MOT is booked for next Tuesday at half 8.

Long catch-up with Eli and Hassan after five a side. Eli's just been told he's coeliac, so he's figuring out what beer he can still drink. Hassan's moving into a flat in Leyton in a fortnight and wants help with the van on the Saturday morning. Told him I'm free. Hassan only drinks Guinness apparently, could bring a few cans as a flat warming thing.
Zhang loves those Japanese whisky miniatures, collects the bottles. Birthday is the 3rd.

Kevin's partner Vanessa is pregnant! Due in March. Kevin was beaming. Vanessa can't stand the smell of coffee now, so the office kitchen has become a problem for her. Need to get them a card this week.
Felix's leaving do on Friday has been called off, his manager asked him to stay till Christmas instead. He seemed relieved honestly.
Carlos and his wife Rosa are celebrating ten years married next weekend. Off to Lisbon Thursday night, back Monday. Rosa's into port so maybe a nice bottle when they're back.
Barbara's grandson Theo starts nursery on Monday morning and she's more nervous than he is. Remind me to ring her Monday afternoon to see how it went.
Batch cook Sunday, freeze half. Book dentist. Bins go out Wednesday night not Thursday this week because of the bank holiday shuffle.
Lindiwe hates coriander with a passion, like genuinely retches. Loves anything with peanuts though.

Chat with Luca at the school gate. His daughter's birthday party is this Saturday 2 till 4 at the soft play. She's mad about dinosaurs right now. Luca said don't bother with presents but I'll grab a small dino book anyway. He's also off booze for October, sober October thing, doing well so far.

Krisztina mentioned her brother Dimitri is visiting from Budapest next Thursday for a week. They're doing the Harry Potter studio tour on the Saturday. He's vegan so she's panicking about where to take him to eat. Could send her that list of places in Shoreditch.
Note to self: Grace said she'd love one of those weighted blankets, she's been sleeping badly since the new job. Christmas idea.
Andre had his interview yesterday morning at the agency. Didn't hear back yet, they said Friday. Must text him Friday afternoon to find out.
Kalani's cat Pickle had to have a tooth out on Tuesday, she's still a bit wobbly. Kalani's been working from home to keep an eye on her.

Caroline Walsh rang about the book club. She's hosting on the 21st at 7.30 and asked everyone to bring a bottle. She only drinks white, and Samir's bringing his famous baklava apparently. I'm doing a cheese board.

Samir told me his mum is having her hip done next Wednesday. He's taking the week off to look after her. Sounds worried but trying not to show it. I should drop round some food on the weekend, he likes that lentil soup I make.
Tendai's into vinyl, mainly old highlife and Afrobeat. Birthday mid November I think. A Fela reissue would go down well.
Reggie (Reginald really but nobody calls him that) is running the half marathon on Sunday morning. First one. Tell him good luck Saturday night.

Sofia and Milan are hosting a housewarming next Friday from 8. Their new place has a garden finally. Milan's doing a barbecue even though it'll be freezing. Sofia's gluten free, Milan isn't but eats whatever she cooks. Thinking a nice olive oil or some plants for the garden as a gift.
Ran out of oat milk again. Also need to renew the parking permit before the 30th.

Bumped into Pedro and Adaeze at the market. Adaeze just passed her driving test, third time lucky! Pedro's birthday is on Thursday and she's planning a surprise dinner at the Ethiopian place. He loves spicy food and craft IPAs. Said I'd come, 7pm Thursday. Don't mention anything if I see him before.
Chris doesn't eat red meat, Rahul's allergic to sesame, and Kevin's doing keto. Menu for Saturday has to work round all three.
Rosa's sister Bethany is getting married in June. Hen do is in Bath in April. Rosa's been asked to organise it and is a bit overwhelmed.
Hassan had his wisdom teeth out on Monday. Face like a hamster apparently. Need to check in tomorrow and see if he wants soup brought round.
Theo turns 6 on the 19th. Barbara says he's obsessed with trains, specifically the Flying Scotsman.
Dentist moved to Friday at 9.15. Gym membership renews next month, decide whether to cancel before then.

Eli said his girlfriend Grace has been really down since her dog passed last week. They had him fourteen years. Eli wants to do something nice for her but doesn't know what. Maybe suggest a framed photo. I should message Grace too, just a short note.
Quick call with Zhang Tanaka about the project dinner. Wednesday at 6.30, Korean BBQ. Zhang doesn't eat pork, so we'll stick to beef and chicken.
Felix's mum is turning 60 in a fortnight. He wants to get her a spa day but his sister thinks jewellery. He's asked me to weigh in. She's into gardening and gin, so I said a gin tasting.
Bogdan's speech went down a storm at his dad's lunch on Sunday. His dad cried. Ask him for a copy of it.
Vanessa's 20 week scan is Tuesday morning. Kevin is taking the day off. Fingers crossed for them.
Barbara MacDonald next door asked if I'd water her tomatoes while she's in Devon from tomorrow until next Sunday. Said yes. She left the key under the blue pot.

Lindiwe and her husband are vegetarian now, both of them, since the documentary. Their kids aren't fussed. Lindiwe's birthday is on Saturday and she wants a quiet one, maybe brunch. Don't forget a card for her, and maybe flowers, she likes sunflowers.
Luca's partner works nights so he's always shattered. Big into espresso, has one of those fancy machines. Christmas: nice beans.

Ok so I had lunch with Krisztina, Carlos and Sunil today. Sunil's retiring at the end of next month after 30 years at the council. Krisztina's organising a collection and wants everyone to chip in by Friday. Carlos is doing the leaving speech and is dreading it, he hates public speaking. Sunil's really into cricket, so maybe tickets to a test match next summer. Must send Krisztina a tenner tonight.
Got to sort the boiler service, call them tomorrow morning. And the car insurance runs out Friday week.
Kalani's parents are coming over from Hawaii for Christmas, first time in three years. She's nervous about cooking for her dad, he's very particular. Hates anything too sweet.
Andre got the job!! Starts on the 4th. He wants to celebrate Saturday night, thinking cocktails. He only drinks rum based stuff. Send congrats now.
Pedro mentioned his brother Milan's band is playing at the Lexington next Friday at 9. Milan plays bass. Might go.
Tendai's girlfriend dumped him on Sunday. He's pretty cut up about it. Going to invite him for a pint this week, he loves that pub with the darts.
Caroline's son Reggie got into Edinburgh for medicine! She's over the moon. He starts in September.
Need to pick up the cake for Saturday Friday after work, the bakery shuts at 5.30 so leave early. Then candles, napkins, ice.
Samir loves Persian food, saffron everything, and is a total tea snob. Prefers loose leaf Earl Grey. Birthday is next Tuesday, I'll get him a tin of the good stuff from Fortnum's.

Dimitri and Krisztina's mum had a fall on Wednesday evening, broke her wrist. She's ok but in a cast for six weeks. Krisztina's flying out to Budapest on Monday to help. Remind me to message her Monday night to see she landed alright.
Sofia's been learning to make sourdough during lockdown and never stopped. Gives loaves out to everyone. Super into baking gadgets, wants a proper banneton.
The quiz on Thursday's been cancelled because the pub's flooded. Rescheduled for next Thursday at 8, same team. Chris and Bethany still in, Eli can't make it.
Grace had her first week at the new firm. Still finding her feet but says the people are nice. Her boss is a bit intense though.

Rahul and his wife have their anniversary on Friday, twelve years. He's booked the Italian on the high street for 8. She doesn't drink so he's ordering a fancy alcohol free bubbly. He wanted ideas for a present, I said a cookbook from the restaurant.
Groceries for the week: chickpeas, spinach, feta, lemons. Also return that jumper by Saturday.

Barbara's husband Kevin (Uncle Kev to everyone) has a cardiology appointment on the 14th at 2pm. Barbara's been fretting about it all week. I should give her a call the evening after to see what they said.

Felix told me his son is doing his grade 3 piano exam on Saturday morning. Kid's been practising non stop and is terrified. Felix is doing a pizza night after whatever happens. Pizza is the kid's favourite, plain margherita only.
Adaeze's cousin in Lagos had a baby girl last week. Adaeze's flying out in a fortnight to meet her. She's taking a suitcase full of baby clothes.
Booked the train to Manchester for Friday the 7th, 10.15 out of Euston. Hotel still to sort.
Zhang's wife has a nut allergy, a serious one, carries an EpiPen. Remember that for the dinner party.

Met Carlos for a coffee. His daughter's sixth birthday party was Saturday and apparently it was chaos, twenty kids and a magician who didn't show. He's still recovering. She got a bike and won't get off it. Ask him for the magician's name so I never book them.
Milan's into rock climbing, goes to the wall Tuesdays and Thursdays. Wants new chalk bag. Birthday next month.

Dimitri said his wife Kalani's 40th is on the 8th, it's a surprise party at their place at 7. He wants everyone there by 6.30 so she doesn't see cars outside. She loves margaritas, so I'm bringing a bottle of tequila. Need to RSVP to him by Sunday.
